summary: Iteration 587 — Segment Pricing, Group Approval, Instant Reprice Bridge, Lost Demand feeding reprice. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed. Frontend: SegmentGroupPanel opens via Cmd+K palette (Pro mode), offset save persists (corporate -10 → -12), group quote created and full approval chain (revenue→sales→approved) works end-to-end, reprice events card shows booking_created / booking_cancelled / lost_demand_price_too_high / manual_test chips with latency. Regression: lost-demand-btn and noshow-risk-btn navigate without crashes.

issues: The base_rate label reads 'Baz fiyat (2026-08-28)' although the code passes tomorrow's date — mostly UX/labeling nit.
'nights' input in group-quote form has no data-testid (only 'ci' date input also missing testid). Consider adding data-testid='quote-nights-input' and 'quote-checkin-input' for testability.

action_items: (optional) Add data-testid to 'nights' and 'ci' inputs in SegmentGroupPanel for consistency.
(optional) The segment-group menu item is only visible in Pro nav mode — expected, but note that new users default to Basit and won't see it without switching.
critical_code_review_comments: fire_reprice uses asyncio.create_task without holding a reference — could cause tasks to be garbage-collected under heavy load. Consider tracking tasks in a set.

Group approval chain hard-codes CHAIN=['revenue','sales']; role validation in approve() only relies on q['status']==f'pending_{role}', which is correct, but there's no explicit RBAC (e.g., only Revenue-dept users can do revenue approval) — currently any admin/manager can approve any step. Consider role-gating in production.

segment_offsets.update_one upsert=True stores a duplicate {'code':'x','name':'X',...} single-item document under property_id — GET later returns just [{code:x,...}] with no defaults. Consider merging with DEFAULT_SEGMENTS or enforcing minimum required codes.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed group quotes and TEST_ lost demand entries; also created a bookings row via POST /api/bookings then cancelled it. All test data flagged with TEST_ / UI_TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Segment-group panel is Pro-mode-only in the sidebar. Easiest way to open the panel in playwright: press Meta+k, type 'Segment fiyat', click the cmdk result. Backend token key is 'token' (not 'access_token'). Reprice events are inserted asynchronously (~2-3 s after the triggering call); tests sleep 3s before asserting.
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested features verified passing.
